title: Localized field-extension base change is faithfully flat
statement: Let k be a field, K/k a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], A a commutative k-algebra, B a finitely presented A-algebra [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], q a prime of B, and q_K a prime of B_K=B\otimes_k K whose contraction to B is q. Then the canonical local homomorphism B_q\to(B_K)_{q_K} [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y, lemma-change-fields-flat): the local map O_{X,x} -> O_{X_K,x_K} is faithfully flat

proof.text: The tensor-product map B\to B_K=B\otimes_k K is faithfully flat by [lem-weil-pbc-field-extension-base-change-faithfully-flat], applied to the k-algebra B.

source.place: faithful flatness of tensoring an algebra by a field extension, used in Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y)

proof.text: Because q_K contracts to q, q_K lies over q for the faithfully flat map B\to B_K. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-ring-maps] to the underlying flat map gives a flat local homomorphism B_q\to(B_K)_{q_K}; its hypotheses hold because the contraction of q_K is q.

source.place: Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y, lemma-change-fields-flat): localization of the faithfully flat field-extension map at x and x_K

proof.text: The source and target are local rings and the localized homomorphism is local. Therefore the flat local map B_q\to(B_K)_{q_K} is faithfully flat by [lem-pc-local-flat-faithful-flat-reflects-surjective], whose first clause states that every flat local homomorphism of local rings is faithfully flat.
